name: item-collision-pair
comment: WP-2.1. Two items spawned overlapping at (0.5, 61.125, 0.5) and (0.6, 61.125, 0.55) (EntityItem positions are box centres) with zero motion: EntityItem never calls applyEntityCollision (only EntityLiving.onLivingUpdate and the minecart/boat do) and returns no collision box (Entity.getBoundingBox / getCollisionBox are null), so they stay overlapped and do not push each other. Entity.applyEntityCollision and isEntityInsideOpaqueBlock are unit-tested on hand-built entities in crates/mc-sim/tests/entity_base.rs. entity_state every tick.
